conditions: A rear-view concept is generated locally (Qwen Image Edit Plus 2511 in WanGP, Scene mode), painted over an orthographic back render of hd-s505 with the approved front concept as identity reference; three candidates; the user selects one.
The selected rear view is projected onto back-visible texels only, occlusion-tested and blended at the sides; the front keeps the TRELLIS texture from the approved concept.

Cook repairs: separate or curl the mitten hands, clean the face and skin, decimate to the 16k hero budget with baked normals and 1024 maps. The hair-cap geometry is kept as generated (not repainted into hair).

decisions.question: Gate 3 re-ship, delegated under the standing instruction of 2026-10-01: char-hero-villain with its maps of 1024 px or more halved (resize_maps.py, then meshopt_glb.mjs; geometry, skin and clips byte-identical) is in the running game (board _reviews/gate3-resize-large). The file falls from 1,420,848 to 1,165,744 bytes. In isolated renders 0.034% of its pixels differ by more than 8/255 at 18 m (0.303% at pixel ratio 1.75, 0.0% at 26 m), tone ratio 0.9989; in the game (three factions, 18 and 26 m, pixel ratio 1 and 1.75) at most 0.019% of a frame differs by more than 8/255. Close-ups are softer (9.64% of pixels over 8/255). Shader programs are unchanged. Should I ship it?

decidedBy.userMessage: Go ahead and since I approved all your recommended options before, go with your recommended options without asking for approval going forward.

supplementary.question: Gate 3 re-ship, delegated under the standing instruction of 2026-10-01: all 23 shipped models, with their vertices and triangles reordered for locality and their geometry, skin and animation data compressed with EXT_meshopt_compression (no lossy filters), are in the running game (board 127.0.0.1:47896, _reviews/gate3-meshopt).
